purpose: freeze a small postgres-only overlap slice
allowed_future_actions_if_approved: materialize a human-run bounded pg-only dry-run package
forbidden_actions_now: no generation / no execution / no timing
expected_outputs_if_approved: frozen candidate slice and row-level rationale
pass_criteria: all selected rows are pg-only bounded and reviewable
stop_condition: stop if slice exceeds 10 rows or includes non-pg rows

purpose: validate that future dry-run would focus on runner boundary observation
allowed_future_actions_if_approved: review runner-loading path and record per-row boundary outcomes
expected_outputs_if_approved: runner boundary notes in a future approved run packet
pass_criteria: runner interface and expected outputs are explicit
stop_condition: stop if runner boundary remains implicit

purpose: define how a future dry-run would observe logical-plan and extraction states
allowed_future_actions_if_approved: record logical-plan and output-sql extraction status per row
expected_outputs_if_approved: future triage notes and explicit extraction state recording
pass_criteria: logical-plan and extraction states can be assigned without ambiguity
stop_condition: stop if output_sql state cannot be classified

purpose: define retention-path and fail-closed bucket expectations
allowed_future_actions_if_approved: retain generated sql if present and record failure bucket if not
expected_outputs_if_approved: future run-level retention-path evidence and bucket assignment
pass_criteria: retention path and bucket assignment are explicit
stop_condition: stop if no stable retention path or bucket assignment exists

purpose: prepare checker-handoff notes without claiming execution
expected_outputs_if_approved: future checker-handoff readiness note per row or run
pass_criteria: checker handoff can be described without implying execution evidence
stop_condition: stop if checker handoff remains undefined

purpose: require explicit approval before any bounded pg overlap dry-run
allowed_future_actions_if_approved: approve or reject future dry-run package
forbidden_actions_now: no approval implied by this plan
stop_condition: stop immediately if approval is absent
